task.description:
Implement the fix for ISS-0121 per the validated design at src/design/iss0121_per_test_uuids.md.

SCOPE OF THIS STEP — MINIMAL IMPLEMENTATION ONLY:
This step adds the new helper method to TestHarness AND migrates ONE focused representative test (tests/integration/audit_chain_utf8_test.zig — the freshest test from prior WF-03) to validate the helper works end-to-end. The remaining 19 files in docs/issues/ISS-0121.json#files_to_change will be migrated in a follow-up incremental migration under a separate workflow ticket (test-quality follow-up).

WAIT — reconsidering scope: the user requested to RESOLVE issue #387 end-to-end. So SCOPE = implement helper + migrate all 19 remaining test files in docs/issues/ISS-0121.json#files_to_change. That is the only way to drive MAJOR count below 10. Do that.

Required actions:

1. In tests/integration/helpers.zig, add to pub const TestHarness (lines 452+):
   ```zig
   pub fn newUuid(self: *TestHarness) std.uuid.Uuid {
       var bytes: [16]u8 = undefined;
       std.crypto.random.bytes(&bytes);
       return std.uuid.Uuid{ .bytes = bytes };
   }

   pub fn newUuidString(self: *TestHarness, allocator: std.mem.Allocator) ![]u8 {
       const u = self.newUuid();
       const out = try allocator.alloc(u8, 36);
       _ = std.fmt.bufPrint(out, "{s}", .{std.fmt.fmtSliceHexUpper(u.bytes[0..4])}[0..8]}) catch unreachable;
       // ... or use std.fmt to print hyphenated form
       return out;
   }
   ```
   Adjust to use Zig 0.16 std APIs. Helper must compile with `zig build` exit 0.

2. For each of the 20 files in docs/issues/ISS-0121.json#files_to_change:
   - Open the file.
   - Identify hardcoded UUID string literals of the form `xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx` used inside INSERT VALUES clauses or function-call parameters.
   - Replace each literal with a local binding `const some_id = try h.newUuidString(allocator);` (or `try self.newUuidString(allocator);` if TestHarness is not the receiver), passed as a parameter binding instead.
   - Allocator is `allocator` (or `std.testing.allocator`) depending on the file's existing convention.
   - Run `python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration` after each file replacement to confirm T010 count drops.
   - Run `zig build` after the helper change to confirm no compile regressions.

3. After all replacements, refresh tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json so that any remaining suppressions only apply to genuinely static UUIDs (e.g. inside JSON fixture blobs, where the literal isn't substituted into SQL).

4. Validate:
   ```
   zig build
   zig build test
   python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration   # BLOCKER=0 MAJOR<=10
   ```

5. Self-review checklist (CLAUDE.md §BACKEND-DEV):
   - No SQL string interpolation.
   - All allocating functions accept std.mem.Allocator.
   - Error types defined in per-module error sets.
   - `python3 tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests` exits 0.
   - No `error.SkipZigTest` on tests covering MUST requirements.

6. Commit:
   ```
   git add -A
   git commit -m "feat(WF03-gh387-20260802): per-test UUID generator on TestHarness (ISS-0121)"
   git push origin feature/WF03-gh387-20260802
   ```

7. Complete the handoff with `completed_at = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')` exact output.

If scope is too large to complete in a single pass, document remaining files in `result.issues` with severity MINOR and proceed with what you can — but the implementation MUST at minimum:
- add the helper to TestHarness,
- migrate at least tests/integration/adp02_tenant_scope_test.zig and tests/integration/iss202_merge_atomicity_test.zig (verifiable drop in lint count),
- ensure `zig build` exits 0.
acceptance_criteria: tests/integration/helpers.zig contains `pub fn newUuid` and `pub fn newUuidString` on TestHarness
`python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration` reports MAJOR count strictly less than 258 (must drop by at least 10)
